description: This PHP class defines a plugin for delivery limitations based on hostname whitelists or blacklists within the Revive Adserver platform. It includes methods for UI display, data sanitization, and compilation of hostname data for ad delivery filtering.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLimitations_Site_Hostnamelist
classes.description: A plugin class for filtering ad delivery based on hostname whitelist/blacklist, with UI display and data processing methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with specific operation labels and sets the plugin name.

methods.name: displayData
methods.description: Displays the UI for the delivery rule.

methods.name: _displayMainUI
methods.description: Renders the main UI for hostname list management, including textareas and buttons.

methods.name: _preCompile
methods.description: Transforms hostname data into a serialized lookup array with puny-code conversion.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the data into a delivery limitation string.

methods.name: _sanitiseData
methods.description: Parses, filters, deduplicates, and sorts hostnames/URLs into a clean list.
